entry.title: 实验室赴杭州参加会议

link.title: 实验室赴杭州参加会议

entry.content: 2025年4月，我实验室成员前往杭州参加了学术会议。在会议期间，我们与来自全国各地的专家学者进行了深入的交流，分享了各自的研究成果和最新进展。通过参与专题报告和分组讨论，不仅拓宽了我们的学术视野，也为后续的科研合作打下了良好的基础。本次会议让我们收获颇丰，对未来的研究方向有了更加清晰的认识。

entry.title: Decarbonising the City webinar
entry.content: Koichi and I will be hosting a webinar on Decarbonising the City at 8 PM - 10 PM (SG/Hong Kong) today. The webinar is part of the International Forum of Urbanism (IFoU) series established by Prof Zhang Ye and Dr. Vivienne Wang to promote exchange and collaboration among early career urban researchers. Our talk will focus on transportation (Koichi), buildings (myself), and post-carbon cities (Hashem, PhD candidate at Politecnico di Torino.Aside from our talks, the talk will feature a 30 minutes panel discussion with Professor Jin Yeu Tsou (Raymond Hu Professor of Architecture, CUHK) and Professor Arno Schlueter (Professor of Architecture and Building Systems, ETH) working on energy and buildings.
